points.description: Where the stems start, for example the points of sample_mesh on a substrate. Every stem starts on a point and grows along its direction instead of from the origin straight up, the stems take the points in turn. Without points the origin is used

amount.description: The amount of stems to produce

fan.description: Spreads the stems out in a fan, the angle between the first and the last, in degrees. Without points they fan out in the plane of x and y, a rotate around x by 90 degrees lays the fan flat for the veins of a palmate leaf. On points the stems of every point make their own fan, in the plane of its direction and tangent. 0 lets them all grow the same way

length.description: How long the stem should be

thickness.description: How thick the stem should be. A path_info length reads the length of the stem, so the thickness can follow it.

resolution_curve.description: How many points along the length of the stem should be created

taper.description: How much the thickness tapers to the tip. 1 = a cone, 0 = the thickness input alone sets the profile.
